abstract: A 21-year-old woman developed psychiatric symptoms, progressive unresponsiveness, generalized seizures, severe dyskinesia, marked fluctuation of blood pressure, and hypersalivation after a flu-like episode. Anti-glutamate receptor (GluR)ε2 and anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) antibodies were positive in both her serum and CSF. After she recovered five months later she underwent surgery to remove a right ovarian teratoma. Immunohistochemical examinations of her teratoma disclosed abundant expression of various GluRs including NR2B subunit of NMDAR, GluR1, and GluR2/3. These immunoreactivities of GluRs were seen not only in small areas of neural tissue identified as anti-glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP)-immunoreactive areas but also in other large areas of undifferentiated neuroepithelial tissue without GFAP immunoreactivity. Our findings strongly support the recent idea that neural elements in ovarian teratoma play an important role in the production of antibodies to NMDARs in anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Additionally, the study of control ovaries clearly showed NR2B-related immunoreactivity in the cytoplasm of oocytes, indicating that the normal ovary itself has expression of NMDARs. This finding might provide a clue to understand the pathogenesis of this disease in female patients without ovarian teratoma.
abstract_ja: 21歳の女性が、インフルエンザ様症状の後に、精神症状、進行する反応低下、全般性痙攣、重度のジスキネジア、著明な血圧変動、流涎過多を発症した。血清および髄液の抗グルタミン酸受容体(GluR)ε2抗体と抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体(NMDAR)抗体はいずれも陽性であった。5か月後に回復した後、右卵巣奇形腫の摘出手術を受けた。腫瘍の免疫組織化学染色では、NMDARのNR2Bサブユニットを含む各種GluR(GluR1、GluR2/3)が豊富に発現していた。これらのGluR免疫反応は、抗グリア線維性酸性タンパク質(GFAP)抗体に反応する神経組織の小領域だけでなく、GFAP免疫反応を示さない未分化神経上皮組織の大きな領域にもみられた。本所見は、卵巣奇形腫内の神経成分が抗NMDAR抗体の産生に重要な役割を果たすという近年の考えを強く支持する。さらに、対照卵巣の検討では、卵母細胞の細胞質にNR2B関連の免疫反応が明確にみられ、正常卵巣自体がNMDARを発現していることが示された。この所見は、卵巣奇形腫を伴わない女性患者における本疾患の病態を理解する手がかりとなる可能性がある。
